preserved.voicePolicy: unchanged upstream 128-voice ceiling; no new cap or early tail termination

method: Controlled windows chase to 180 s, play 15 s, restore current user transport. CPU mean/max use one-second diagnostic averages, not the worst individual audio block. Final sanity uses 6 s with later user-enabled Light reverb settings. No QEMU or full-song soak.
limitations: Remaining individual block deadline overruns, including with reverb.
The maximum render time in diagnostic snapshots is cumulative within its boot, not a per-window maximum.
Row chase does not reconstruct tails and effect history before the chased row.
The final sanity window has a different duration and later reverb settings; it is not an A/B against the 15 s windows.
